caveats.en: GPU rendering with OptiX was tested on the 5.3 beta; the review does not say whether the build is native Arm64. Microsoft's Surface Arm FAQ lists Blender as running natively on Arm, but that is not RTX Spark specific.
caveats.zh-TW: OptiX GPU 算圖是以 5.3 Beta 實測，該評測未說明是否為原生 Arm64。微軟 Surface Arm 常見問題將 Blender 列為原生 Arm 執行，但並非針對 RTX Spark。

evidence.title: XDA: Blender scene rendered on RTX Spark
